title: 002. Valid Anagram
prompt: Given two strings `s` and `t`, return `true` if `t` is an anagram of `s`, and `false` otherwise. An anagram uses all the original lowercase letters rearrangements.

hints.title: Mental Model & Intuition
hints.content: Think of a 26-pan balance scale (`a` through `z`). Every letter in `s` adds +1 weight to its letter pan, and every letter in `t` subtracts -1 weight.

hints.title: Pattern Identification
hints.content: A fixed 26-integer frequency array (`[0] * 26`) achieves `O(N)` time and `O(1)` auxiliary space, beating sorting (`O(N log N)`).

hints.title: Algorithmic Invariant
hints.content: First guard `if len(s) != len(t): return False`. Then iterate `i` from `0` to `len(s)-1`, incrementing `count[ord(s[i]) - ord('a')]` and decrementing `count[ord(t[i]) - ord('a')]`.

hints.title: Edge Cases & Scaffolding
hints.content: Verify strings of different lengths (`s='a', t='ab'`) exit immediately on line 1, and single-character strings (`s='z', t='z'`) return `True`.
